subtitle: A layered ice cream sundae with shortbread, chocolate and toffee sauces, suited to diners who enjoy rich, sweet desserts.

components.name: Vanilla ice cream
components.note: Soft vanilla ice cream forms the smooth, cold base of the sundae, contrasting with the crumbly shortbread pieces.

components.name: Shortbread pieces
components.note: Crumbly, buttery shortbread adds biscuit crunch between the soft ice cream and the drizzles of sweet sauce.

components.name: Belgian chocolate sauce
components.note: Rich Belgian chocolate sauce brings chocolate flavour to the layers, alongside the vanilla ice cream and toffee sauce.

components.name: Sticky toffee sauce
components.note: Sweet, sticky toffee sauce adds another layer of sweetness, complementing the chocolate sauce and buttery shortbread pieces.

taste:
This is a rich, sweet sundae built around the contrast between cold, soft ice cream and crumbly shortbread. Vanilla provides the base flavour, while the buttery biscuit pieces add crunch. Belgian chocolate sauce and sticky toffee sauce bring distinct chocolate and toffee flavours, making it a better fit for someone seeking sweetness than a restrained finish to a meal.

Served in a tall glass, the layers give you ice cream, biscuit and sauce to combine as you eat. A spoonful with shortbread has more texture than one dominated by ice cream and sauce. It suits eating alone if you want a rich dessert, or sharing if you prefer a smaller amount.
value:
The value here lies in getting ice cream, biscuit and both sauces together, rather than choosing a dessert centred on cake or pudding. At a typical {price}, it is worth considering if that combination is what you want. Our comparison places it as {pricePosition}.

Compare it with Warm Chocolate Fudge Cake or Sticky Toffee Pudding if you are choosing by dessert style rather than price alone. Mini Warm Chocolate Brownie is another named option to check. Prices vary by pub, so confirm the local menu before deciding.

bestFor.title: Fans of sweet sundaes
bestFor.text: Choose this if your preferred dessert combines cold ice cream with plenty of sweetness. Chocolate and toffee sauces give it more going on than vanilla alone.

bestFor.title: Biscuit texture lovers
bestFor.text: The shortbread pieces make this a useful choice for diners who want crunch alongside soft ice cream, rather than a dessert with a uniform texture.

bestFor.title: A dessert to share
bestFor.text: Sharing suits diners who want to taste the ice cream, biscuit and sauces without each ordering a whole sundae. Ask for an extra spoon when you order.
